blocks.text: Setting up your technical writing environment on Mac

The official ChatGPT desktop app for macOS is the best way to integrate AI into your workflow. Download it from the official site to ensure you have the latest version. Once installed, press Option + Space to open the companion window from any app. This keeps your writing flow uninterrupted while you query the model.
How to use ChatGPT for technical writers on Mac effectively

Technical writers often struggle with context switching. When you are editing in iA Writer or Typora, use the ChatGPT companion window to quickly generate definitions or format Markdown tables. Avoid pasting entire proprietary codebases into the chat. Instead, provide small, relevant snippets to get accurate explanations.

blocks.text: Managing your time as a technical writer

Since you spend so much time in meetings, use ChatGPT to summarize transcripts. Record your meeting with an app like Otter or Mac native audio tools, then paste the text into ChatGPT. Ask it to extract action items, technical requirements, and SME feedback. This saves you hours of manual note-taking.

faq.question: Can ChatGPT replace a technical writer?
faq.answer: No. ChatGPT is a tool for drafting and research, but it lacks the product knowledge and user empathy required to create high-quality documentation.

faq.question: How do I ensure my documentation remains accurate?
faq.answer: Always test the steps in your documentation against the actual product. AI can generate plausible but incorrect command syntax or UI paths.

faq.question: Is it safe to use ChatGPT with sensitive company data?
faq.answer: Check your company's policy on using AI tools. You can turn off chat history in ChatGPT settings to prevent your data from being used for model training.
